name: TAZ Workhorse 2
description:
The LulzBot TAZ Workhorse 2 offers an unmatched user experience in 3D printing, built on years of development and practical experience, ensuring reliability and ease of use. 
 
 
 Central to its advancements is the Galaxy Series   Meteor 175 Tool Head , a game-changer in printing efficiency and reliability. This Tool Head was meticulously designed for ease of use with Predefined tension settings, ensuring optimal performance and consistency with minimal effort. 
 
 
 Blue Spring Steel Magnetic Build Plate System : This feature revolutionizes the printing process, providing a strong, reliable hold for materials during printing and effortless removal of finished products. 
 
 Smooth y-axis linear rail system for precision movement and less maintenance requirements.   
 
 Built-In Runout Sensor : Enhancing reliability, this sensor alerts users to filament shortages, preventing print failures - saving both time and resources. 
 
 
 Improved Firmware Features: The Workhorse 2 boasts firmware enhancements that streamline operations, improve print quality, and offer a more intuitive user interface. The new "Present Bed" function is one such feature. 
 
 
 These improvements collectively contribute to a seamless printing experience, making the TAZ Workhorse 2 not just a tool for creation but a dependable partner for innovators, educators, and professionals seeking efficiency and excellence in their 3D printing projects.

name: M175 v2 Tool Head
description:
LulzBot honors your freedom to print. Be sure to check out the new Meteor 175 Tool Head, a great successor to the M175 v2 Tool Head. 
 Add 1.75 mm filament capability to your LulzBot 3D printer and open up an even wider variety of 3D printing materials.  The M175  v2 Tool Head is here to bring the world of 1.75 mm material to your LulzBot Mini 2, TAZ Workhorse, and TAZ Pro.  
 The 1.75 mm dual-drive extruder on the new LulzBot M175 v2 Tool Head feeds material reliably. Built to handle the toughest industrial-strength materials to the most basic materials, the M175 v2 prints a wide range of filament - from nylon and soft flexible materials to PLA and rigid and brittle carbon-filled high-strength materials.  
 Material changes are easy using the quick release lever.  A thumbscrew tensioner allows the you to fine-tune the pressure exerted by the drive gears onto the filament. It provides uninterrupted material flow without fear of grinding or slipping.  
 The lightweight hot end provides superior heat break performance - it conducts 85% less heat than a standard threaded heat break. The small hot end mass allows for more rapid motion.  
 
 The M175 v2 Tool Head comes with a 0.5 mm Bridgemaster™ nozzle for beautiful, high-resolution prints. 
 The sturdy fan duct mounts with one screw and has been designed for maximum efficiency using airflow analysis to ensure even 360° part cooling. The fan duct also provides a clear view of the printing surface so you can inspect layer quality during printing.

name: Push Plastic PC/PBT Filament
description:
PC+PBT is a polycarbonate filament alloy from Push Plastic that excels in balancing print stiffness, structural integrity, and impact strength with superb filament ductility. PC+PBT filament produces sturdy, quality prints with excellent fatigue performance and a high chemical resistance to motor oil and grease. 
 
 Filament Specifications 
 Filament Diameter: 2.85mm (0.11 inches) 
 Amount of Filament: 750g (1.65 lbs) 
 Filament Colors: Black and White 
 Printing Specifications 
 Hot End Temperature Range: 235°C-255°C 
 Print Surface: 110°C-120°C; PC+PBT filament is a polycarbonate-based material, therefore applying a glue stick (such as Elmer's® brand) directly to the print surface before starting your LulzBot 3D printer is strongly recommended for increased printed object adhesion. 
 Packaging Information 
 PC+PBT filament ships vaccum sealed and mounted on a reel. 
 Storage Information 
 Store your filament in an air tight container. The use of desiccant is especially encouraged in humid environments as PC+PBT filament will absorb moisture from the air.

name: Polymaker PolyMax PC
description:
PolyMax™ PC and PolyMax™ PC-FR by Polymaker are among the toughest and strongest 3D printable filaments available. 
 PolyMax™ PC  filament has an advanced polycarbonate-based material that unites impressive mechanical strength, fine surface finishes, and superior heat resistance. 
 PolyMax™ PC-FR  has additional flame retardant properties making it ideal for automotive, aerospace, and railway industries. 
 
 Printing Specifications 
 Special Tool Head Requirements:  LulzBot HE Tool Head 
 Hot End Temperature Range: 250°C - 270°C 
 Print Surface: PEI film recommended with a glue stick (such as Elmer's® brand) applied to the print surface prior to powering on your LulzBot 3D printer. Maintain the print surface by powering off your LulzBot and cleaning the glue stick residue with a soft cloth and water. 
 Print Surface Temperature: 90° - 105°C 
 Packaging Information 
 PolyMax™ PC and PC-FR filament ships vacuum sealed and mounted on a reel. 
 Storage Specifications 
 Store your filament in an air tight container. The use of desiccant is encouraged as polycarbonate-based filament will absorb moisture from the air.

This makes n-vent a premium alternative to HIPS, the versatile filament for beginners. When 3D printed, n-vent has a glossy surface finish, is strong and dimensionally accurate due to it's low shrinkage and excellent layer adhesion. n-vent is made with Eastman Amphora by Eastman Chemical Company.     Filament Specifications Filament Diameter: 3 mm (0.12 inches) Amount of Filament: 1 lb (0.45 kg) Average Length of Filament: 60m Filament color may vary Printing Specifications Special Tool Head Recommendation: LulzBot Hexagon Hot End recommended Hot End Temperature Range: 230°C-240°C Print Surface: PEI print surface recommended Print Surface Temperature: 60°C To make removing 3D printed n-vent objects easier, we strongly recommend applying a glue stick (such as Elmer's® brand) to the print surface prior to powering on your LulzBot 3D printer. Maintain the print surface by powering off your LulzBot and cleaning the glue stick residue with a soft cloth and water. Packaging Information Sold in a sealed air-tight pouch, this filament is loaded onto a reel.

name: Taulman T-Glase Filament
description: Taulman t-glase PETT filament 3D prints well while also offering a high degree of translucence. Models printed in t-glase have a great surface finish, can reflect light well, and depending on the part geometry, can even shimmer and gleam. One of the more exciting characteristics of this Taulman 3D printer filament is its ability to act as a light pipe to transmit light. Use larger layer heights for enhanced translucence. Filament weight remains the same. T-Glase filament ships vacuum sealed and mounted on a reel

name: IC3D PLA
description:
IC3D PLA 3D printer filament is the first and only Certified Open Source Hardware 3D printer filament. IC3D has published their filament production process which includes documentation on equipment used, settings and parameters, material grade, and sources.

name: Polymaker Polylite PLA
description:
PolyLite™ by Polymaker offers excellent 3D printing performance, a vibrant palette of colors, and will become your affordable, go-to choice. This premium filament 3D prints reliably and has minimal warping and shrinking compared to other materials, perfect for applications featuring flat surfaces and hard angles, or requiring tight tolerances for fit. 
 Formulated to have reliable feeding and is available in a wide variety of colors, offering both opaque or translucent qualities. PLA is commonly used for prototypes, educational and architectural models, and artifact replicas. It can also be treated with a variety of post-processing techniques. PLA is a popular choice for users looking to paint objects after they have been printed, such as costume props and figurines.  
 Filament Specifications 
 
 Filament Diameter: 2.85 mm (0.11 inches) 
 Amount of Filament: 1 kg (2.2 lb), or 3 kg (6.6 lb) 
 Filament color may vary 
 
 
 Printing Specifications 
 Special Tool Head Requirements: LulzBot Hexagon Hot End recommended 
 Hot End Temperature Range: 205°C 
 Print Surface: PEI film recommended. 
 Print Surface Temperature: 60°C 
 
 Packaging Information 
 Polylite PLA filament ships vacuum sealed and mounted on a reel.

 Spring Steel laminated with PEI and polycarbonate

 OctoGrab was derived from work by Tim Pierce in the LulzBot community

name: BASF Ultrafuse TPU
description:
750g spools. 
 BASF Ultrafuse TPU is the best for industrial applications that need flexibility, durability, and abrasion resistance.  World materials leader BASF has brought their high-quality TPU material Elastollan to 3D printing, and Ultrafuse TPU is the result. This high flexibility and durability TPU is used in countless applications, and now it's available as an affordable and reliable 3D printing filament, perfect for any project requiring give and flex. 
   
 Ultrafuse® TPU 95A comes with a well-balanced profile of flexibility and durability. On top of that, it allows for easier and faster printing then softer TPU grades. Due to its good printing behavior, Ultrafuse® TPU 95A is a good choice for starting flexible materials. 
 Ultrafuse® TPU 85A offers a broad range of degrees of hardness with different designs, making this filament an ideal material in applications where specific degrees of flexibility are critical. 
 Ultrafuse® TPU 64D is the hardest elastomer in BASF Forward AM’s flexible product line. The material shows a relatively high rigidity while maintaining a certain flexibility.

name: Taking Tinkercad to the Next Level Book
description:
If you are a student, hobbyist, tinkerer, or maker familiar with the basic features of Tinkercad and want to learn how use it to create complex designs and models for 3D printing, this book is for you. While it focuses on intermediate and advanced techniques in Tinkercad, beginners looking to expand their CAD skills and explore 3D printing will also benefit.   
 Discover key techniques and strategies for developing 3D models using computer-aided design software 
 Navigate advanced features and tools in the intuitive Tinkercad software 
 Harness your own creativity and knowledge to expertly craft unique 3D models and creations 
 Understand the difference between common 3D printing techniques, and choose the best one for your needs 
 Troubleshoot mistakes and become a more proficient maker 
 Apply your skills to identify problems, design solutions, and manufacture prototypes for the real world 
 Discover the user-friendly interface and versatility of Tinkercad and find out how it’s revolutionizing digital creation. This comprehensive guide explores Tinkercad’s 3D design features, equipping you with the skills to harness its full potential for advanced projects and creations. Written by a patented inventor and Tinkercad expert with over a decade of experience in technology education, this book offers an accessible, yet thorough approach to mastering Tinkercad for users of all levels. You'll enhance your 3D design skills as you delve into professional modeling topics and techniques in Tinkercad. As you progress, you’ll build your skills by mastering essential tools for 3D modeling, such as technical drawings and measurement methods, paving the way for efficient constructive solid geometry abilities. Advanced Tinkercad modeling techniques, including ruler and workplane tools, patterns, and shape generators, will guide you in bringing your designs to life through 3D printing. You'll also learn about advanced concepts such as tolerances, dimensions, material choice, and practical applications with step-by-step guides for creating items like threaded containers, puzzles, phone cases, and more. By the end of the book, you’ll be proficient in crafting intricate designs ready for successful production through 3D printing.   Book Specifications Publication date : Sep 30, 2024 Length: 418 pages Edition : 1st Language : English ISBN-13: 9781835468005

name: Polymaker PolyLite ASA
description:
Description  
 All the strength of ABS, even under the sun. PolyLite™ ASA is an alternative to ABS with an improved weather resistance.  Print Settings 
 
 Nozzle Temperature:   ±240˚C - 260˚C 
 
 Print Surface Temperature: 75˚C - 90 ˚C 
 
 Printing Speed: 30mm/s - 50 mm/s 
 Print Surface: PEI 
 Cooling Fan: OFF 
 Enclosure Recommended 
 
 Tips  
 Drying ASA can improve it's printability if it has been left unprotected for a long period of time. It's recommended to have a humidity controlled storage box for ASA filament. 
 Drying Settings: 70˚C for 6h

This product is for R&D use only and is not intended for human or other uses. Please consult the Material Safety Data Sheet for information regarding hazards and safe handling practices. Item is shipped overnight  via insulated cold package . Item must be received and placed in refrigeration immediately. Conditions for safe storage, including any incompatibilities: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place.  Recommended storage temperature 2 - 10°C. Heat sensitive.  Storage class (TRGS 510): Non-combustible, corrosive hazardous materials   Lifeink ®  240 produces printed structures with a high print resolution and good mechanical strength. The product is formulated in an acidic saline buffer solution. Once the collagen is printed into LifeSupport ® , the pH and salts concentration of the printed structure become physiological. Cells can then be seeded onto the printed structure allowing for cell adherence and cellular remodeling of the 3D bioprinted structure.

name: Proto-Pasta PLA
description: Conductive PLA Unleash your inner electrical engineer with this exciting new premium 3D printing filament. Since 3D printed objects have varying structures within them, the resistance across the 3D printed object varies as well! The resistance of the 3D printed object can be different when measured across the sides of the object than the resistance when measured from the top to the bottom. Magnetic Iron PLA This iron-bearing premium 3D printing filament is attractive to magnetic fields. The finely ground iron particles also add a distinctive heft to 3D printed objects. On average they will weigh 50% more than a comparable item printed in PLA. Stainless Steel PLA Stainless Steel PLA filament by Proto-pasta brings metal 3D printing home by combining the familiarity of PLA with finely ground stainless steel powder. Start your next project with this metal 3D printing filament.     Conductive PLA Filament Diameter: 2.85 mm (0.11 inches) Amount of Filament: 500g (1.1 lbs) Average Length of Filament: 77 m Filament color may vary Estimated resistance of 3D printed parts when measured perpendicular to the layers along the X/Y axis: 30 ohm-cm Estimated resistance of 3D printed parts when measured through the layers along the Z axis: 115 ohm-cm Printing Specifications Special Tool Head Requirements: LulzBot Hexagon Hot End with 0.50mm nozzle recommended Hot End Temperature Range: 215°C-230°C Print Surface: PEI film recommended Print Surface Temperature: 60°C

name: TAZ Pro S
description:
Overview 
 
 
 The LulzBot TAZ Pro S gives you a single extrusion 1.75mm tool head, superior 3D print quality, and easy, professional results. 
 
 Single Extrusion tool head 
 1.75mm extruder prints a wide variety of 1.75mm filament  - from TPU and nylon to PLA, ABS, and rigid carbon-filled high-strength materials.  
 Dual nickel coated hardened steel drive gears provide unparalleled pushing power, lightning fast retraction, and uninterrupted material flow without fear of grinding or slipping. 
 Large 280 x 280 x 285 mm build volume with heated build plate. 
 Automated X/Y/Z offset calibration, nozzle wiping, and self-leveling features. 
 Enhanced 32-bit electronics for greater processing power, more memory, and quiet operation.  
 Filament runout detection. 
 Cable chain and reinforced electrical connectors for long wire harness life. 
 5" full color touch screen. 
 Made in USA 
 A 1kg spool of PLA filament is included to be used in your first 3D print, the LulzBot   Rock2pus !

name: TAZ Dual Extruder V3.1 Tool Head
description:
The re-engineered LulzBot TAZ Dual Extruder v3.1 Tool Head is back by popular demand to take your designs to the next level.  Improved air flow at the heat sink means this trusty Tool Head is now even more prepared to utilize dedicated support material like  PolyDissolve S1 , that dissolves and separates in water, freeing you to focus on the function of your design rather than on how to make it 3D printable.   
 This dual filament extruder does not require nozzle leveling or offset calibration, is lighter and more compact than its predecessor, and features improved heat sink and part cooling. With hassle-free hardware, integrated software, and water-soluble support material, who knew geometric freedom could be this easy?

name: Polymaker PolyCast
description:
PolyCast™ is a variant of the PolySmooth resin (PVB) manufactured by Polymaker. It is a filament designed to produce investment patterns for investment (lost wax) casting applications. It prints as easy as PLA, burns out clean (0.003% ash residue), can be smoothed and/or dissolved with isopropyl alcohol, and cuts and sands like ABS. 3D printed patterns with PolyCast enables more complex geometric shapes than is possible with molded wax by injection molding. 
     Filament Specifications Filament Diameter: 2.85 mm (0.11 inches) Amount of Filament: 750 g (1.65 lbs) Printing Specifications Hot End Temperature Range: 190-220°C Do not exceed 280°C Print Surface: Applying a glue stick (such as Elmer's® brand) directly to the PEI print surface before starting your LulzBot 3D printer is strongly recommended for increased printed object adhesion. Packaging Information PolyCast filament ships vacuum sealed and mounted on a reel. Storage Specifications Store your filament in an air tight container. The filament arrives in a resealable bag recommended for storage. The use of desiccant is encouraged as PolyCast filament will absorb moisture from the air.

description:
This all-in-one TAZ Pro 3D printer motherboard is made by UltiMachine using a 32bit Atmel SAM3X8E processor and comes equipped with Trinamic TMC2130 stepper drivers all on one integrated PCB, built in fuses, and more. 
 
 Does not come with pre-installed firmware

 Parts Included 
 • One (1) Archim3 electronics board 
 Specifications 
 
 
 Designed and Manufactured by UltiMachine 
 
 
 Logic 
 
 
 Archim3 is supported in mainline Marlin Firmware as BOARD_ARCHIM 
 
 
 Crystals for both usb and mcu (timing accurate to 10ppm) 
 
 
 4 Thermistor jacks 
 
 
 All extra pins broken out on both processors (allows using the 32u2 for LUFA AVR programmer, etc.) 
 
 
 2 channel SDRAMPS compatible SPI breakout 
 
 
 
 
 Stepper Drivers 
 
 
 5 TMC2130 1/8th microsteps motor drivers with 1,1/2,1/4,1/16 as options (2 connectors for Z-axis) 
 
 
 SPI (Serial Peripheral Interface) communicated motor current control (no tiny knobs to tweak) 
 
 
 Current limit on driver IC VCC to prevent permanent latchup 
 
 
 Microstep mode configured by MCU through firmware (no jumpers needed) 
 
 
 Test points for driver control signals 
 
 
 Step and Direction pins are on their own ports for synchronous movement capability 
 
 
 Extra driver ports broken out for up to 3 additional drivers (some of the motor extension pins are shared with max endstop and a pin allocated for SPI-SS extensions) 
 
 
 
 
 PWM DC outputs (Extruders, Fans, Etc.) 
 
 
 6 outputs 
 
 
 Low resistance mosfets for cool running 
 
 
 Indicator led for each channel 
 
 
 
 
 Power 
 
 
 Three ATC fuse protected power rails 
 
 
 Heated Bed, 15A 12-35V 
 
 
 Extruders + fans and logic, 5A 12-35V (fuse can be exchanged for up to 10A capacity) 
 
 
 Motors, 5A 12-28V (fuse can be exchanged for up to 10A capacity) 
 
 
 SMPS supports hostless printing on power supply voltages from 10-24V DC 
 
 
 
 
 PCB 
 
 
 4 layer 
 
 
 2oz copper on all layers 
 
 
 High quality, High temperature FR4-TG130 PCB 
 
 
 Gold ENIG finishing 
 
 
 
 
 Fuses 
 
 
 3 user replaceable automotive fuses; 
 
 
 F2: automotive-type 5A ATO bladed fuse for motors and on-board power supply

description:

 Logic 
 
 Arduino MEGA compatible Atmega2560 and Atmega32u2 processors are compatible with all RAMPS class firmwares 
 Crystals for both usb and mcu (timing accurate to 10ppm) 
 4 Thermistor jacks

name: SE Tool Head
description:
Versatility and precision come standard with the LulzBot SE Tool Head, featuring the Universal Mounting System, and the legendary Titan Aero Hot End and Extruder from E3D. This tried and true combination enables a vast palette of supported 3D printing material, both rigid and flexible.

 A high-output centrifugal fan and quad-port cooling duct support elaborate prints with extensive bridging, cooling filament in 360-degrees before it has time to sag between points. 
 The Universal Mounting System makes swapping tool heads easy, you'll have the right tool head for the right job installed in minutes.

name: colorFabb nGen
description:
ColorFabb nGen filament is engineered for prototyping and production. This co-polyester filament by colorFabb brings together the strength and precision found in Eastman Amphora ™  3300 3D polymer, optimized for desktop 3D printing.  It also exhibits minimal warping and responds well to post-processing techniques like sanding. 
 
 Filament Specifications 
 Filament Diameter: 2.85 mm (0.12 inches) 
 Amount of Filament: 0.75 kg (1.65 lbs) 
 Filament color may vary 
 Printing Specifications 
 Special Tool Head Recommendation: LulzBot Hexagon Hot End recommended 
 Hot End Temperature: 230°C 
 Print Surface: PEI print surface recommended 
 Print Surface Temperature: 85°C 
 To make removing 3D printed nGen objects easier, we strongly recommend applying a glue stick (such as Elmer's® brand) to the print surface prior to powering on your LulzBot 3D printer. 
 Maintain the print surface by powering off your LulzBot and cleaning the glue stick residue with a soft cloth and water. 
 Packaging Information 
 Sold in a sealed air-tight pouch, this filament is loaded onto a reel.

name: HS Tool Head | 0.8 mm
description:
The LulzBot HS Tool Head is purpose-built for high-strength 3D printing applications utilizing durable industrial composites and is ideal for engineers needing strong parts and faster printing times.   The ability to create functional jigs, fixtures, and prototypes on-site in a matter of hours significantly reduces lead time and cost. 
 Featuring a hardened steel nozzle and extruder hobb, this 3D printer extruder head is capable of printing high-strength composite polymers on par with PEEK's tensile strength (15,200 psi - ASTM638). These polymers are used in a wide range of high-demand applications, from structural components to the automotive industry. 
 Parts printed with these composites have higher impact resistance, resist deformation, while retaining strength in harsh and demanding environments. Industrial materials like PA-CF Low Warp combine strength and dimensional stability (less than 2% elongation at break - ASTM638) with the ability to perform in higher operating temperatures up to approximately 120° C (248° F). 
 Filament Tension Settings

name: SL Tool Head | 0.25 mm
description:
Achieve superior detail and surface quality with the LulzBot SL Tool Head. Ideal for engineers, artists, and designers, this high-precision 3D printer head offers layer heights as low as 0.05 mm for tight tolerances and minimal post-processing. Enjoy the ease and reliability of the LulzBot ecosystem, including Cura LulzBot Edition software and Marlin firmware. With layers thinner than 1/30th of a penny's thickness, this tool head excels in precision printing. 
 The LulzBot SL Tool Head features a genuine E3D Titan Aero Extruder/Hot End with a 0.25 millimeter nozzle enabling out of the box 3D printing at resolutions as low as 0.05 mm layers, or 50 microns! Advanced users can achieve even finer resolutions. This high-precision 3D printer head is currently compatible with the LulzBot Mini 2, TAZ Workhorse and TAZ Pro  3D Printers . LulzBot TAZ 5/6 and Mini 1 users will also be able to enjoy high-detail printing with the Universal Tool Head Adaptor. 
 A high-output centrifugal fan and quad-port cooling duct support elaborate prints with extensive bridging, cooling filament in 360-degrees before it has time to sag between points. Lightweight and compact, the SL connects quickly and easily to bring high-resolution 3D prints to your LulzBot 3D Printer.  
 This tool head is intended for advanced users, and produces precision prints with impeccable detail. Some users have asked about different aspects of its capabilities:  
 
 Discouraged Filament: 
 Due to the small nozzle diameter of this 3D printer extruder head, use of abrasive or composite (wood-filled, metal-filled, etc.) filament is not recommended due to the potential risk of clogging.

The LulzBot Bio is a FRESH™ certified bioprinter ready to print bioinks, unmodified collagen, and other soft materials for pharmaceutical/cosmetic testing, tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, and so much more.

name: colorFabb PA-CF
description:
PA-CF Low Warp by ColorFabb is strong, durable, and engineered to bring dimensional stability to industrial-strength nylon, making it ideal for engineers looking for stronger prints with faster turn-around times. Parts printed with this industrial nylon 3D printer filament have higher impact resistance, resist deformation, while retaining strength in harsh and demanding environments. This unique and premium blend combines strength and dimensional stability (less than 2% elongation at break - ASTM638) with the ability to perform in higher operating temperatures up to approximately 120° C (248° F). name: Esun PVA Filament
description: With PVA filament, you can print intricate designs with overhangs, internal structures and other difficult geometries that you have not been able to print before. Once printed, our water-soluble 3D printer filament will dissolve away after soaking, leaving your model clean and intact with very little clean up. Packaging Information PVA filament ships vacuum sealed and mounted on a reel. Storage Specifications Store your filament in an air tight container. The use of desiccant is encouraged as PVA filament will absorb moisture from the air.

Coming on a fully recycled cardboard spool and utilizing recycled packaging and labels to minimize waste.  Polymaker will also plant one tree for every spool sold of PolyTerra in it's place of purchase!     Print Settings 
 Nozzle Temperature: 190 ˚ - 230˚C 
 Printing Speed: 30mm/s - 70 mm/s Bed Temperature: 25˚ - 60˚C Bed Surface: PEI Cooling Fan: ON Mechanical Properties 
 Young's Modulus: 1882  ± 141 Mpa 
 Tensile Strength: 20.9 ± 2.0 Mpa Bending Strength: 39.6 ± 1.1 Mpa Charpy Impact Strength: 5.7 ± 0.4 kJ/m2 Thermal Properties 
 Glass Transition Temperature: 60.6 ˚C 
 Vicat Softening Temperature: 62.7˚C Melting Temperature: 162.6˚C Notes 
 Drying Settings: 55 ˚C for 6h 
 Recommended Support Materials: PolyDissolve™ S1, PolySupport™ Packaging 
 Packaging Weight: 1.4kg Spool Dimensions: 65 x 20 cm 
 Box Dimensions: 23 x 21 x 8 cm

name: TAZ Pro Galaxy Dual Upgrade Kit
description:
Includes everything you need to easily upgrade your existing TAZ Pro or TAZ Pro S. 
 From the Twin Nebula 285 Tool Head for precision with multi-material printing, to the upgraded magnetic flex bed for simplified part removal, each component has been carefully selected to give you the best printing experience. Unlock the full potential of your TAZ Pro or TAZ Pro S with this incredible upgrade kit! 
   
 What's Included 
 (x1)  Twin Nebula 285 Dual Tool Head 
 (x1)  TAZ Pro/Workhorse Magnetic Flex Bed v2 
 (x1)  TAZ Pro Jetpack: Jam & Runout Sensor Kit 
   
 Instructions 
 OHAI Installation for Tool Head ➡ 
 OHAI Installation for Magnetic Flex Bed ➡ 
 OHAI Installation for Jetpack Runout Sensor ➡

name: TAZ Workhorse+ Upgrade Kit
description:
Take your 3D printer to the next level! 
 Includes everything you need to easily upgrade your existing TAZ Workhorse 3D printer into a TAZ Workhorse+. 
 From the robust Meteor 285 Tool Head, which ensures ease of use and superior flexible (TPU) printing, to the upgraded magnetic flex bed for simplified part removal, each component has been carefully selected to give you the best printing experience. Unlock the full potential of your TAZ Workhorse with this incredible upgrade kit! 
 What's Included 
 (x1)  Meteor 285 Tool Head 
 (x1)  TAZ Pro/Workhorse Magnetic Flex Bed v2 
 (x1)  TAZ Workhorse/TAZ 6 Filament Runout Sensor 
   
 Instructions 
 OHAI Installation for Tool Head ➡ 
 OHAI Installation for Magnetic Flex Bed ➡ 
 OHAI Installation for Filament Runout Sensor ➡ 
 ⓘProp. 65 warning  
   
 *Requires an existing TAZ Workhorse 3D Printer, Part Number KT-PR0051 *For use with Cura LE version 4.13.10 and above

name: TAZ Pro Galaxy Upgrade Kit
description:
Take your 3D printer to the next level! 
 Includes everything you need to easily upgrade your existing TAZ Pro 3D printer into a fully upgraded TAZ Pro S 3D printer. 
 From the robust Meteor 285 Tool Head with BLTouch leveling sensor, which ensures ease of use and superior flexible (TPU) printing and rapid bed leveling, to the upgraded magnetic flex bed for simplified part removal, each component has been carefully selected to give you the best printing experience. Unlock the full potential of your TAZ Pro with this incredible upgrade kit! 
 What's Included 
 (x1)  Meteor 285 Tool Head 
 (x1)  TAZ Pro/Workhorse Magnetic Flex Bed v2 
 (x1)  TAZ Pro Jetpack: Jam & Runout Sensor Kit 
 (x1)  TAZ Pro S - BLTouch® Adapter Kit 
   
 Instructions 
 OHAI Installation for Tool Head ➡ 
 OHAI Installation for Magnetic Flex Bed ➡ 
 OHAI Installation for Jetpack Runout Sensor ➡ 
 OHAI Installation for BLTouch sensor ➡ 
 
   
 *Requires an existing TAZ Pro 3D Printer, Part Number KT-PR0050/55 *For use with Cura LE version 4.13.10 and above
